Discover the versatility and comfort of the 2026 Toyota Sienna LE 8 Passenger, a minivan designed to meet the needs of families and groups who demand both practicality and reliability.

- Handicap accessible features
- 8 speakers with AM/FM radio and SiriusXM
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C and rear air conditioning
- Power driver seat with telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Lane Departure Warning System
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off functionality
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbag, and overhead airbag
- Emergency communication system: Safety Connect (1-year trial)
- 17" alloy wheels
- Split folding rear seat with reclining 3rd row seat

The 2026 Sienna LE delivers impressive fuel efficiency with 36 MPG in both city and highway driving, making it an economical choice for frequent travel. The spacious 8-passenger configuration provides ample seating for your family or group, while the convenient split folding rear seat and reclining third-row option ensure flexibility for both passengers and cargo. With seating for eight, you have room for everyone and their belongings.

Safety remains a priority with comprehensive features including Electronic Stability Control, traction control, brake assist, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS. The Lane Departure Warning System helps keep you aware of your position on the road, while the exterior parking camera provides added confidence during reversing maneuvers. Safety Connect emergency communication system offers additional peace of mind with a one-year trial included.

Climate control throughout the vehicle ensures comfort for all passengers. The automatic temperature control system maintains your preferred cabin temperature, while front dual zone A/C allows driver and passenger to set independent preferences. Rear air conditioning and rear window defroster keep those in back comfortable on any journey.

Entertainment and connectivity remain at your fingertips with the Toyota Audio Multimedia system featuring eight speakers, AM/FM radio with SiriusXM capability, and seamless integration with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage your entertainment without taking your hands from the wheel.

The White exterior combined with body-color bumpers and alloy wheels presents a clean, modern appearance. Power door mirrors, heated for winter months, and a variably intermittent rear window wiper support practical daily driving. HomeLink garage door transmitter integration adds another layer of convenience to your ownership experience.

This front-wheel-drive configuration provides stability and control in various driving conditions while optimizing fuel efficiency for your daily commute and longer road trips alike.

This Elite model stands apart with its suite of advanced safety technologies. Dual front impact and side impact airbags, along with knee and overhead airbags, work in concert with Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and four-wheel independent suspension to keep occupants secure. Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow takes the stress out of highway and stop-and-go traffic driving.

The heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort for cold-weather drives. Memory seat settings let you personalize your driving position, while the power passenger seat and reclining third-row seat ensure every occupant finds their ideal comfort zone. The splits of the folding rear seat provide flexible cargo configurations for families with diverse needs.

Connectivity and convenience are seamlessly woven throughout the cabin. The 500-watt premium audio system and steering wheel-mounted controls let you adjust music and settings without taking your hands off the wheel. The power moonroof bathes the cabin in natural light and fresh air.

The Sonic Gray Pearl exterior finish presents a sophisticated appearance that commands respect on any roadway. Nineteen-inch machine-finished alloy wheels contribute to the vehicle's refined stance while supporting dynamic handling. Rain-sensing wipers and auto-dimming exterior mirrors adapt to changing weather and light conditions, enhancing both safety and convenience.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the 2026 Honda Odyssey Elite firsthand. This vehicle represents a substantial investment in your family's comfort, safety, and peace of mind.

This well-equipped 2021 Toyota Sienna XSE 7 Passenger in silver offers practical family transportation with proven reliability and efficiency.

- All Weather Floor Liners
- Cross Bars
- XSE Plus Package with Roof Rails
- Premium JBL Audio System with 12 speakers and subwoofer
- 9" Touchscreen with Dynamic Navigation
- Wireless Charger
- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay
- SiriusXM with 3-month All Access trial
- Wi-Fi Connect capability
- 1500W Inverter Output
- Power Moonroof
- Heated Front Seats
- Three-row seating for seven passengers
- Rear Power Liftgate
- Lane Departure Warning System

The Sienna presents an organized interior designed for everyday family use. Seven passenger seating accommodates larger groups comfortably, with split-folding rear seats providing flexibility for cargo when needed. The third row features a reclining design, while front bucket seats include power adjustment and heating for driver and passenger comfort. SofTex seat trim resists wear from regular family activities.

Technology serves practical purposes throughout this minivan. The 9" touchscreen integrates Android Auto and Apple CarPlay for smartphone connectivity, while the premium JBL audio system with 12 speakers and subwoofer delivers clear sound for passengers. The wireless charger accommodates compatible devices, and six USB charge ports distribute power for multiple occupants. Safety Connect provides emergency communication features, and the navigation system includes dynamic routing capability.

Safety features include a comprehensive airbag system with dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and rear side impact airbags, plus an overhead airbag. Lane Departure Warning alerts help maintain lane position, Electronic Stability Control supports vehicle control, and a rear parking camera assists during reversals. Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars provides handling stability.

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine delivers 35 city and 36 highway mpg, offering practical fuel economy for a seven-passenger vehicle. All-wheel drive capability enhances traction in varied conditions, while the continuously variable transmission provides smooth power delivery. The 1500W inverter output enables standard electrical device charging for portable tools and equipment.

Convenience features throughout reflect family-focused design. The power moonroof brings natural light to the cabin, the rear window wiper aids visibility, and exterior parking camera rear view supports safe maneuvering. Power door mirrors with heating and auto-dimming capability enhance driver awareness, while auto high-beam headlights and front fog lights improve visibility during varied driving conditions. HomeLink garage door transmitter provides keyless entry to home garages.

This Sienna represents solid family transportation ready for your household needs. With its combination of seating flexibility, practical technology, safety systems, and fuel efficiency, it delivers dependable minivan value for families prioritizing passenger accommodation and versatility.

This 2021 Toyota Sienna XLE 8 Passenger is a spacious family vehicle designed to accommodate your entire household with comfort and convenience in mind.

- Special color red exterior with roof rails
- 8-speaker audio system with SiriusXM and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear dual-zone air conditioning
- Power driver and passenger seats with heated front bucket seats
- Lane Departure Warning System and Electronic Stability Control
- Power liftgate and rear window wiper
- Exterior parking camera and 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Safety Connect emergency communication system with 3-year trial
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Reclining third-row seats with split folding capability
- 17-inch alloy wheels
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and fully automatic headlights

The Sienna seats up to eight passengers across three rows, making it an excellent choice for families who need flexibility and room for everyone. The third-row seating can be configured to suit your needs, with a split-bench design that allows for cargo space when not in use. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading, while the exterior parking camera provides visibility when maneuvering in tight spaces.

Climate control throughout the cabin ensures passenger comfort on any journey. The front dual zone air conditioning and separate rear controls mean front and rear passengers can each set their preferred temperature. Rear air conditioning and a rear window defroster work together to keep back-seat travelers comfortable in any season.

Inside, you'll find thoughtful amenities that make daily driving and longer trips more enjoyable. The leather-trimmed steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement to the cabin. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel. The HomeLink garage door transmitter integrates seamlessly into your daily routine, eliminating the need to carry a separate remote.

This vehicle delivers reliable performance with a 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with a CVT transmission and front-wheel drive, achieving 36 MPG in both city and highway driving. That efficiency means fewer stops at the pump and more time enjoying the road with your passengers.

Safety is integrated throughout the Sienna, with dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned to protect all three rows. The Lane Departure Warning System actively assists you on the road, while the Electronic Stability Control and traction control systems work to maintain stability in challenging conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension provides a composed ride that absorbs road imperfections while maintaining control.

When you're ready to experience the comfort and utility this family vehicle offers, we invite you to visit our showroom for a closer look and test drive.

The Pacifica Hybrid Pinnacle combines the practicality of seven-passenger seating with the efficiency of hybrid technology. With its 3.6L V6 engine paired with hybrid capability, this vehicle balances power and fuel economy for families managing daily commutes, school runs, and longer journeys. The spacious interior accommodates passengers and cargo with flexible seating configurations, while the caramel leather trim and premium appointments create an inviting environment for everyone aboard.

Interior comfort extends beyond basic amenities. Heated front seats with ventilation adjust to your preferences, while the power driver and passenger seats with memory functions ensure personalized positioning for each occupant. The telescoping and tilt steering wheel, along with remote keyless entry and illuminated entry, make transitions smooth whether you're arriving home or heading out. The overhead console and garage door transmitter add practical touches for daily convenience.

This certified pre-owned vehicle arrives with comprehensive warranty protection and peace of mind. The package includes a 125 Point Inspection, 24-Hour Towing and Roadside Assistance, Vehicle History Report, CARFAX® documentation, and an introductory 3-month SiriusXM® subscription. The Powertrain Limited Warranty covers 84 months or 100,000 miles from the original in-service date, while the additional Limited Warranty provides 3 months or 3,000 miles coverage after the new car warranty expires. A $100 warranty deductible applies, and this warranty is transferable to subsequent owners.

Safety features throughout the Pacifica Hybrid Pinnacle protect your family on every drive. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work in conjunction with Electronic Stability Control and traction control. An occupant sensing system and low tire pressure warning keep you informed, while the panic alarm and security system provide additional layers of protection.

At 45,348 miles, this Silver Mist Clearcoat finish vehicle displays well-maintained condition. The exterior includes body-color bumpers, bodyside moldings, and heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators. Four wheel independent suspension with heavy duty capability and four-wheel disc brakes ensure responsive handling and reliable stopping power.

This 2023 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Limited offers the practicality and sophistication your family deserves in a modern minivan designed for everyday living.

- 3.6L V6 with CVT transmission providing smooth, efficient power delivery
- Uconnect 5 Nav with 10.1" touchscreen display and integrated navigation
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Premium Nappa leather bucket seats with heating and ventilation
- Power moonroof for added light and open-air comfort
- Heated front seats and heated steering wheel for cold-weather driving
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning
- 13-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Power liftgate and split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo management
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and exterior parking camera
- Four-wheel independent suspension with heavy-duty setup
- Electronic stability control and traction control for confident handling
- Dual front-side impact airbags and knee airbags for occupant protection
- Alloy wheels with 17-inch diamond-cut design

The Pacifica Hybrid Limited delivers a refined driving experience enhanced by premium materials and intuitive technology. The leather-appointed interior combined with heated and ventilated front seats creates an inviting environment for driver and passengers alike. The power-adjusted driver's seat with memory functionality allows you to store your preferred seating position, while the rear row's reclining split-bench seat and third-row configuration provide comfortable seating for the entire family.

Whether navigating city streets or highway drives, this hybrid delivers the efficiency modern families expect. The integrated navigation system guides you reliably, while the comprehensive climate control system keeps everyone comfortable regardless of season. The power moonroof adds an element of spaciousness to the cabin, and the rain-sensing wipers adapt automatically to changing weather conditions.

Safety is paramount in this Pacifica Hybrid Limited, equipped with multiple airbags throughout the cabin, electronic stability control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and an emergency communication system through Uconnect Access. The exterior parking camera assists when reversing, while traction control and the four-wheel independent suspension provide confidence during various driving conditions.

With 45,171 miles, this vehicle has been responsibly maintained and remains well within its operational lifespan. The combination of a proven 3.6L V6 engine paired with hybrid efficiency makes this a sensible choice for families seeking both performance and economy.

Contact us today to schedule your test drive and experience how this Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Limited can enhance your family's daily journeys.

This 2023 Honda Odyssey Sport in striking red combines practical family transportation with thoughtful design and reliable performance that suits busy households.

- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active safety technology
- Blind Spot Information (BSI) System with warning
- Power liftgate for convenient access
- Heated front bucket seats with power adjustment
- Leather seat trim and steering wheel
- Dual front and rear climate zones with automatic temperature control
- Power moonroof
- 19-inch gloss black alloy wheels
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- 160-watt SiriusXM audio system with seven speakers
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display

The Odyssey Sport delivers an efficient 19 city and 28 highway mpg, making it practical for daily commuting and longer trips alike. The minivan's three-row seating accommodates your entire family, with split-folding rear seats and a reclining third row that adapt to your changing cargo and passenger needs. Fine-tuned suspension and speed-sensing steering provide composed handling while the 4-wheel disc ABS brakes with brake assist deliver confident stopping power.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin with heated front seats, a power driver's seat with memory function, and dual front zone air conditioning that keeps everyone comfortable. The leather steering wheel and tilt-telescoping adjustment ensure every driver finds their ideal position. Overhead console storage and multiple door bins provide practical organization for daily essentials.

- Roadside Assistance

- Honda Care Roadside Assistance for 2 year/100,000 miles (whichever occurs first). Up to two complimentary oil changes within the first year of ownership. SiriusXM 90-Day Trial.

Safety remains central to the Odyssey Sport's design, with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and occupant sensing airbag technology work together with electronic stability control and traction control to protect your family during unexpected events.

The auto high-beam headlights and fog lights enhance visibility in various driving conditions, while the rear window wiper and speed-sensitive wipers keep your sightlines clear. An auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during nighttime driving, and the delay-off headlight feature provides extra illumination as you approach your home or destination.

This Honda True Certified vehicle has been thoroughly inspected and comes backed by comprehensive warranty coverage and roadside assistance. - BLUETOOTH

This Odyssey combines practicality with comfort features designed for everyday driving. The 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission delivers responsive performance, while front-wheel drive provides confident handling. With an EPA estimate of 19 city and 28 highway MPG, this vehicle balances efficiency with capability. The spacious interior accommodates passengers across three rows, with the third row featuring split-bench seating and a recline function for added versatility.

The cabin offers comfort and convenience through multiple amenities. Dual-zone automatic temperature control keeps passenger areas at preferred settings, while heated front seats and a power-adjustable driver seat with memory function enhance daily comfort. The 160-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM audio system with steering wheel controls, coupled with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, keeps you connected throughout your journey. Remote keyless entry, a power liftgate, and auto-dimming rear-view mirror with HomeLink further streamline operation.

This vehicle arrives as a certified pre-owned Honda with a clean Carfax history and one previous owner. Certification provides additional assurance regarding the vehicle's condition and quality standards.

Safety and driver assistance technologies include Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping Assist System active guidance, and a Blind Spot Information System warning feature. The backup camera provides clear visibility when reversing, while multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and ABS brakes work together to protect occupants. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering contribute to controlled handling in various driving conditions.

The silver exterior paired with 19-inch machine-finished alloy wheels presents a contemporary appearance. Additional features include front and rear fog lights with fully automatic headlights, exterior parking camera, heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, and variably intermittent wipers. The power moonroof adds an element of openness to the driving environment.

We invite you to schedule a time to view and test drive this Odyssey at your earliest convenience. Our team is ready to answer questions and help you determine if this vehicle meets your transportation needs.

This 2023 Toyota Sienna XSE 7 Passenger offers the practicality and comfort your family needs, wrapped in an elegant beige exterior that makes a refined statement on the road.

- Rear Seat Entertainment system for long trips
- Premium JBL Audio with Navigation
- Power moonroof for open-air enjoyment
- Heated front seats with power adjustment
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear dual zones
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Lane Departure Warning System for enhanced safety
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Exterior parking camera with rear view

The Sienna delivers efficiency without compromise, achieving 36 mpg in both city and highway driving. The 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission provides smooth acceleration while minimizing fuel consumption. Front-wheel drive enhances traction and frees up interior space for passengers and cargo, making every journey more convenient.

With seating for seven passengers, this van accommodates large families or groups with ease. The third-row split-bench seats recline to provide comfort on extended drives, while the split-folding rear seat offers flexibility for cargo configuration. Heated front seats ensure comfort during colder months, and the power passenger seat adjusts to individual preferences.

Safety is prioritized throughout this vehicle's design. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to maintain grip in various driving conditions. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. Lane Departure Warning alerts you if drift occurs, while the four-wheel disc braking system with ABS provides confident stopping power.

Climate control is sophisticated and zone-specific, with automatic temperature management for the driver and front passenger, plus independent rear and rear dual-zone controls. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the rear window defroster and variably intermittent wipers ensure visibility in all weather conditions.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine. The navigation system guides you reliably, while smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps you connected. The rear-seat entertainment system keeps passengers engaged, and the 1500W inverter output powers devices for the entire family. Visit our showroom to experience the Sienna's blend of family-friendly features and dependable performance firsthand.

The 2024 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L with the S Appearance Package delivers the combination of style, functionality, and family-focused capability you're looking for in a modern minivan.

- Power Liftgate
- Uconnect 5 w/10.1" Touchscreen Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heated front seats with memory positioning
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Caprice Leatherette interior with S Logo accents
- Piano Black interior trim details
- 20" S-Model aluminum wheels with premium styling
- Black Stow 'N Place roof rack
- Premium front and rear fascias with black surround accents
- Anodized Ice Cave interior accents
- Heated steering wheel
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with AWD

This minivan comes equipped with genuine family-friendly features designed for everyday convenience. The Uconnect 5 infotainment system with its 10.1-inch touchscreen keeps you connected through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading simpler, while the ParkView rear camera provides added confidence when backing up. Climate comfort is addressed through automatic temperature control with front dual-zone capabilities, heated front seats, and a heated steering wheel for cooler months.

The S Appearance Package adds distinctive visual appeal with coordinated styling throughout. Black day light opening moldings, premium fascia designs, anodized ice cave accents, and the distinctive 20-inch aluminum wheels create a cohesive, refined look. The piano black interior trim and Caprice leatherette seating with S logo embroidery contribute to an upscale cabin environment.

Performance and safety are priorities with this Pacifica. The 3.6L V6 24-valve VVT engine paired with the 9-speed 948TE automatic transmission provides dependable power. All-wheel drive enhances traction and stability, while the four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control and traction control delivers composed handling. The comprehensive airbag system, ABS brakes, and low tire pressure warning support your peace of mind on the road.

With only 6,123 miles on the odometer, this vehicle is essentially new and ready for years of reliable service. Real-world efficiency comes in at 17 city and 25 highway MPG, giving you reasonable fuel economy for a vehicle in this class. The combination of low mileage, complete feature set, and Touring L appointments makes this an excellent choice for families seeking practicality without compromise.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics

- Automatic Headlights
- Backup Camera
- Bluetooth Hands-Free
- Collision Avoidance System
- Collision Warning System
- Heated Seats
- iPod/MP3 CONNECT
- Keyless Access with Push Button Start
- Leather Seats
- Multi Zone Climate Control
- Third Row Seating
- Touchscreen Controls
- Voice Recognition
- Power Moonroof
- AM/FM Radio with SiriusXM

The gray exterior presents a clean, neutral appearance that complements any setting, while the 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive performance. With city fuel economy of 19 MPG and highway fuel economy of 28 MPG, this front-wheel-drive vehicle balances capability with reasonable efficiency for regular driving needs.

Inside, the cabin reflects the EX-L's commitment to comfort and convenience. Leather seats heated for warmth during cooler months, multi-zone climate control to keep all passengers satisfied, and power-adjustable seating create an inviting environment. The third row of seating provides flexible space configuration, whether you need to accommodate additional passengers or expand cargo capacity. Touchscreen controls and voice recognition put key functions within easy reach, while the power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to the driving experience.

Safety and awareness features underscore this vehicle's design priorities. Collision avoidance and warning systems work to alert you to potential hazards, while the backup camera aids visibility during reversing. Electronic stability control, anti-lock brakes, and a comprehensive airbag system address protection from multiple angles. The HomeLink garage door transmitter adds convenience to your daily routine.

Entertainment and connectivity are seamlessly integrated. Bluetooth hands-free calling keeps you connected safely, and iPod/MP3 integration through the touchscreen interface means your music travels with you. SiriusXM radio adds content variety to your commute or travels.

Byers Auto is family owned and operated and has been serving Central Ohio in the automotive industry since 1897. This 2015 Honda Odyssey Touring Elite combines practicality with refined comfort, delivering a reliable minivan designed for families who value both capability and convenience.

- Backup Camera with Park Distance Control
- Blind Spot Assist with Rear Traffic Alert
- Lane Keep Assist
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Navigation System
- Leather Seats with Heated Front Seats
- Power Moonroof
- Premium AM/FM/CD Audio System with SiriusXM
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front and Rear Dual Zone A/C
- Power Liftgate
- Memory Driver Seat
- High-Intensity Discharge Headlights
- 18" Alloy Wheels
- HomeLink Garage Door Transmitter
- Electronic Stability Control

The Odyssey's 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission provides solid performance with ratings of 19 city and 28 highway MPG. This front-wheel-drive configuration delivers the balance of efficiency and capability that makes this model a trusted choice for active families managing multiple schedules and destinations.

Interior appointments reflect the Touring Elite's premium positioning. Leather seats trimmed throughout the cabin combine with heated front seating to enhance comfort during daily commutes and longer journeys. The comprehensive driver-assistance suite—including backup camera, blind spot detection with rear traffic alert, lane keep assist, and adaptive cruise control—helps you maintain confidence behind the wheel in varied driving conditions.

Technology features facilitate both entertainment and navigation. The navigation system guides you to your destination while the premium audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio and twelve speakers delivers quality sound throughout the cabin. Automatic dual-zone climate control ensures comfort for all passengers, while the power moonroof adds an open-air element to drives through pleasant weather.

Practical conveniences round out this Odyssey's appeal. The power liftgate simplifies cargo loading, rear air conditioning keeps passengers comfortable, and the split-folding rear seat configuration adapts to your changing storage needs. Speed-sensing power steering and the independent suspension system contribute to responsive, composed handling across different road surfaces.

Safety receives appropriate attention with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, anti-whiplash front head restraints, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and electronic stability control working together to help protect occupants. The occupant-sensing airbag system and low tire pressure warning add additional layers of protection.

This Odyssey Touring Elite stands ready to support your family's mobility with proven Honda reliability and the thoughtful features that make daily driving more manageable and pleasant.

This 2024 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L offers a well-appointed family vehicle designed to meet your daily transportation needs with confidence and reliability.

- 3.6L V6 engine delivering dependable performance
- 9-Speed Automatic transmission for smooth operation
- Uconnect 5 with 10.1" touchscreen display and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration
- Dual zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning
- Heated front seats and heated steering wheel for comfort
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- ParkView rear back-up camera for safe maneuvering
- Three-row seating with split-folding rear seat and reclining third row
- Caprice leatherette bucket seats with memory driver's seat
- SiriusXM satellite radio with integrated steering wheel controls

- 4-Wheel disc brakes with ABS and dual front airbags plus overhead and knee airbags
- 17-inch aluminum alloy wheels
- Rain-sensing windshield wipers

The Pacifica Touring L delivers practicality with its versatile interior layout. The spacious cabin accommodates passengers comfortably, while the configurable seating and split-folding rear seat provide flexibility for both passengers and cargo. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading convenient, particularly when managing families and their belongings.

Driver comfort and convenience features are well-represented in this model. The heated front seats, heated steering wheel, and dual-zone climate control with rear air conditioning ensure passenger comfort across seasons. Power-adjustable driver's seat with memory function, telescoping and tilt steering wheel, and remote keyless entry all contribute to an intuitive driving experience.

Technology integration keeps you connected on the road. The Uconnect 5 system with its 10.1-inch touchscreen provides accessible control over your vehicle's functions and entertainment. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility allow seamless smartphone integration, while the SiriusXM satellite radio offers entertainment options throughout your travels. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep functions within easy reach.

Safety and visibility receive appropriate attention with Electronic Stability Control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and comprehensive airbag protection. The ParkView rear back-up camera, front fog lights, fully automatic headlights, and rain-sensing wipers enhance your ability to see and be seen in various conditions.

With 52,148 miles on the odometer, this Pacifica Touring L remains an attractive option for those seeking a functional family vehicle. The 3.6L V6 provides reasonable fuel efficiency at 19 city and 28 highway MPG. This is a vehicle ready to serve your family reliably for years to come.

Introducing the 2024 Kia Carnival LX, a thoughtfully engineered minivan designed to meet the needs of families who value both capability and comfort.

- Carpeted floor mats for all eight passenger positions
- Three rows of seating with reclining third row and split folding rear seat
- Front bucket seats with center armrest for enhanced comfort
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Rear air conditioning with independent climate control
- Power windows, door locks, and mirrors with heated mirror elements
- Remote keyless entry for convenient access
- Tilt and telescoping steering wheel for personalized positioning
- 17-inch clear silver painted alloy wheels
- Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars
- Speed-sensing steering that adjusts responsiveness to driving conditions
- Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and brake assist
- Automatic high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality
- Six-speaker audio system with steering wheel-mounted controls and AM/FM radio

The Carnival LX is powered by a V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive, delivering 19 city and 26 highway miles per gallon. The spacious three-row layout accommodates up to eight passengers, making it ideal for larger families or those who regularly transport multiple occupants. The second and third rows feature flexible configurations, allowing you to recline the third row or fold the rear seats completely to maximize cargo space when needed.

Safety is paramount in this design. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee and overhead airbags, and a comprehensive suite of electronic safety systems including four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control. Low tire pressure monitoring and occupant sensing technology provide additional peace of mind.

Climate control extends throughout the cabin with air conditioning in the front and dedicated rear air conditioning, ensuring all passengers remain comfortable regardless of weather conditions. Power-operated features including steering, windows, and mirrors—along with convenience elements like the leather shift knob, illuminated entry, trip computer, and outside temperature display—contribute to an easy, refined driving experience.

The red exterior presents a bold, distinctive appearance, complemented by body-color bumpers, a rear spoiler, and turn signal indicator mirrors. Variably intermittent front wipers and a rear window wiper with independent control ensure optimal visibility in all conditions.

We invite you to visit our showroom to examine this capable family hauler firsthand and experience the comfort and functionality the Carnival LX offers.

description:
This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L offers the practicality and comfort your family deserves from a modern minivan. With its White exterior and well-maintained condition, this vehicle presents a reliable choice for those seeking spacious, dependable transportation.

- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC 24V engine with 9-Speed Automatic transmission
- 7-passenger seating with leather seat trim and heated front bucket seats
- Power moonroof for enhanced cabin brightness and ventilation
- Blind Spot Information (BSI) System warning for enhanced awareness
- Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS) with Forward Collision Warning
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active for lane departure prevention
- 160-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM audio system with 7 speakers
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Power liftgate for convenient rear access
- Power driver and passenger seats with memory settings
- Heated front seats and heated door mirrors
- Dual zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Rear parking camera for backing and parking assistance
- 18" Dark Silver-Painted Alloy wheels
- HomeLink garage door transmitter for smart home connectivity

The cabin prioritizes both comfort and functionality. Leather seating surfaces combine with heated front seats to provide warmth during cooler months, while the dual zone climate control and rear air conditioning ensure all passengers stay comfortable regardless of their seating position. The power moonroof floods the interior with natural light, creating an open, airy atmosphere that makes the cabin feel larger.

Technology integration is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to access navigation, music, and communication features through your smartphone. The 160-Watt SiriusXM audio system delivers quality sound throughout the cabin, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep entertainment and phone functions within easy reach.

Safety features provide peace of mind for you and your family. The Collision Mitigation Braking System actively works to prevent or reduce impact severity, while Forward Collision Warning alerts you to potential hazards ahead. Lane Keeping Assist helps maintain your position in your lane, and the Blind Spot Information System provides warnings when vehicles are detected in your blind spots. The rearview camera assists with parking and reversing maneuvers.

The spacious interior accommodates seven passengers with split-folding rear seats and a reclining third row, making this Odyssey ideal for families or those regularly transporting groups. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading cargo, while the efficient 9-speed automatic transmission balances power delivery with an EPA-estimated 19 city and 28 highway fuel economy.

This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L combines practical family transportation with modern convenience and safety features, ready to serve your household dependably for years to come.

- Electronic Stability Control
- Rear Window Defroster

The Grand Caravan SE Plus combines functionality with everyday comfort. With seating for up to seven passengers and flexible Stow 'N Go seating in the second and third rows, this minivan adapts to your life—whether you're hauling passengers or cargo. The 3.6L V6 engine delivers solid performance, achieving 17 mpg in the city and 25 mpg on the highway, making it efficient for family trips and daily commuting.

Inside, you'll find an intuitive layout designed for convenience. The 6.5" touchscreen display integrates with Bluetooth audio and phone connectivity, allowing you to stay connected safely while driving. Uconnect Voice Command keeps your hands on the wheel and eyes on the road. Dual-zone front air conditioning and rear air conditioning with heater ensure all passengers travel comfortably, regardless of weather.

Safety is built into every drive. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes work together to keep you secure on the road. The ParkView rear back-up camera eliminates guesswork when reversing, while multiple airbags and anti-whiplash front head restraints provide comprehensive protection for your family.

This minivan has been meticulously maintained. With just 26,609 miles, it represents excellent value, and its clean Carfax history and Deery Certified status—backed by a 3-month/3,000-mile warranty—give you confidence in your purchase. The accident-free history means this vehicle is ready for years of reliable service.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this Grand Caravan SE Plus firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you understand why this minivan is an excellent choice for your family.

Safety comes standard with dual front airbags, side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag system. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension contribute to controlled handling and stability on various road conditions.

This Pacifica Touring L Plus represents solid family transportation that prioritizes space, comfort, and connectivity for everyday driving.

description:
Introducing this 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L, a family minivan engineered to deliver reliable transportation and thoughtful amenities for the everyday demands of your household.

- 160-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM Audio System with 7 speakers
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Heated front bucket seats with power adjustment and memory functions
- Leather seat trim with split folding rear seat and 3rd row seating
- Power moonroof for added light and ventilation
- Blind Spot Information System warning and Lane Keeping Assist System
- Collision Mitigation Braking System with forward collision warning
- Rear backup camera for convenient parking assistance
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Heated door mirrors and auto high-beam headlights
- 18" dark silver-painted alloy wheels
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Emergency communication system with HondaLink
- Power liftgate with remote operation
- Reclining 3rd row seat with split folding 2nd row design

This Odyssey is powered by a 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine paired with a 9-Speed Automatic transmission, delivering balanced performance with 19 city MPG and 28 highway MPG. The front-wheel-drive configuration ensures stable handling while the four-wheel independent suspension provides a composed ride across various road conditions.

The EX-L trim prioritizes comfort and convenience for the entire family. Heated front seats with power adjustment and memory functions ensure personalized driving positions, while the full leather interior adds an upscale feel to the cabin. The spacious three-row seating accommodates up to seven passengers, with flexible folding configurations to adapt to your cargo or passenger needs on any occasion.

Safety remains paramount in this minivan's design. Multiple airbags, including knee airbags and overhead protection, create a comprehensive safety net. The electronic stability control, traction control, and anti-lock braking system work together to maintain vehicle control in challenging driving conditions. Lane Keeping Assist, Collision Mitigation Braking, and the Blind Spot Information System provide active guidance to help prevent accidents before they occur.

Modern technology integrates seamlessly into daily use through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, allowing access to navigation, messaging, and entertainment apps directly from the 160-watt audio system. The rearview camera simplifies parking maneuvers, while HomeLink enables wireless garage door operation from the vehicle. HondaLink provides emergency communication capabilities and vehicle-related support when needed.

This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L combines the practicality essential to family life with the features expected in a premium minivan. We invite you to visit our showroom to explore this vehicle firsthand and experience the thoughtful design that makes it a capable choice for your family's transportation needs.

This 2019 Ford Transit Connect XLT is a versatile work vehicle designed to help you accomplish your daily tasks with proven reliability and practical efficiency.

- Roof rails for secure cargo carrying
- 16" sparkle silver-painted aluminum alloy wheels
- SYNC 3 communications and entertainment system
- Forward and reverse sensing system
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone air conditioning
- Rear air conditioning
- Rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera
- Fully automatic headlights with front fog lights
- Power driver seat and power door mirrors
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- SiriusXM radio with 6 speakers

Power windows, power steering, and a telescoping tilt steering wheel contribute to an accommodating driving environment. The 4-spoke steering wheel with mounted audio controls lets you manage entertainment and communication features without taking your hands off the wheel.

Safety is integrated throughout this vehicle's design. The dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags work together with an occupant sensing system. Forward and reverse sensing, rear parking sensors, and an exterior parking camera assist you when maneuvering in tight spaces. Electronic stability control, traction control, and 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confidence in various driving conditions. The SYNC 3 emergency communication system can connect you with emergency services if needed.

Technology integration centers on the SYNC 3 system, which provides radio, SiriusXM satellite radio, and smartphone connectivity through steering wheel controls. The rain sensing wipers and rear window wiper with variable intermittent settings adapt to weather conditions automatically. Automatic headlights with delay-off functionality and fog lights improve visibility in challenging lighting situations.

This white Transit Connect represents a practical choice for buyers seeking a capable commercial or personal vehicle with straightforward features and solid construction. With low mileage for its model year, it offers room to grow into your ownership experience. Come see what this Transit Connect can do for your lifestyle or business operation.

Discover the practical luxury of the 2020 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Limited, a vehicle that combines family-focused comfort with intelligent hybrid efficiency. This white minivan arrived as a one-owner vehicle with low mileage and remains well-maintained, ready to serve your family's transportation needs for years to come.

- Hybrid powertrain with 3.6L V6 engine
- Advanced SafetyTec Group with Adaptive Cruise Control and Stop & Go functionality
- 360 Surround View Camera System for enhanced visibility
- 20 Speaker Harman/Kardon Sound System with 760 Watt amplifier
- Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus and Lane Departure Warning Plus

- Uconnect Theater with streaming and Blu-Ray/DVD player
- Navigation System with 8.4" touchscreen display

- Split-folding rear seating with three-row flexibility

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration

The Pacifica Hybrid's thoughtful interior design prioritizes passenger comfort and convenience. The premium leather trim throughout the cabin sets an elevated tone, while the heated steering wheel and heated front seats ensure comfort during cooler months. Split-folding second and third-row seating accommodates various cargo configurations, and the reclining third-row seats allow rear passengers to customize their travel experience. Seatback video screens with USB ports provide entertainment options for passengers during longer drives.

Safety features meet and exceed modern standards with comprehensive protection. The Advanced SafetyTec Group includes adaptive cruise control that maintains following distance and brings the vehicle to a complete stop when needed, full-speed forward collision warning, lane departure warning plus, and the 360 surround view camera system that provides multiple viewing angles for parking and maneuvering. Advanced brake assist, automatic high beam headlamp control, and rain-sensitive windshield wipers respond intelligently to road conditions.

The premium audio experience distinguishes this Pacifica from standard minivans. The 20 Speaker Harman/Kardon system powered by a 760-watt amplifier delivers concert-quality sound throughout the cabin, enhanced by integrated active noise cancellation that ensures dialogue clarity and audio fidelity. The three-channel wireless headphones provide independent listening options for different passengers.

Uconnect Theater transforms the minivan into a mobile entertainment hub, featuring streaming capability, Blu-Ray and DVD playback, and USB connectivity. The navigation system with its 8.4-inch display provides intuitive route planning and real-time information. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps your smartphone functionality accessible while maintaining focus on the road.

This 2020 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Limited represents a mature selection for families prioritizing safety, comfort, and technology. With low mileage and single-owner history, it offers dependable transportation combined with the hybrid efficiency that reduces fuel costs without compromising capability. We invite you to visit and experience how this minivan's comprehensive feature set addresses the practical demands of modern family life.

The practical design of this minivan makes family outings and cargo transport straightforward.
